Tom (Eng): Hey folks — planning a permanent move SF -> Dublin, target move date Apr 15. What do I need to do for homebase, payroll switch, WFH stipend proration, and shipping my desk/monitor?
Sara (People Ops): congrats! we'll need you to fill the relocation form and confirm permanent status. steps: tax assessment, payroll cutover, benefits update, equipment shipping vs reimbursement. can you confirm citizenship/visa status and exact move date? :tada:
Tom (Eng): Irish citizen, no visa. move date Apr 15. will be permanent.
Mike (Payroll): noted. payroll cutover options: immediate switch to Irish payroll or stay on US payroll for up to 90 days then transfer. tax withholding differs. if you switch immediately you'll have irish PAYE deductions and potential pension contributions.
Sara (People Ops): for WFH stipend — we prorate by month of homebase change. e.g., switch effective Apr 15 -> half month for Apr. we'll also need your new address in BambooHR.
Lisa (Legal): flag — moving employee to IE may create local statutory obligations (pension, social insurance). we'll need payroll vendor to confirm and update employment jurisdiction. also check any contract clauses about governing law.
Tom (Eng): for equipment: desk + monitor + monitor arm. can company ship to IE or should I pay and request reimbursement? budget ~€900.
Priya (Relocations Coordinator): we can ship to EU via our vendor up to $1,500 allowance. please complete equipment shipping form: https://redwood.internal/relocations/ship (include customs info). if vendor can't ship we can pre-approve reimbursement — keep receipts.
Mike (Payroll): action: Tom, share your final US pay date and whether you want to switch payroll immediately or after a period (30/60/90). we'll prepare withholding estimates for both scenarios.
Sara (People Ops): i'll open a relocation case and assign a coordinator. Priya will own shipping logistics and liaise with payroll/legal. expecting to post a checklist by EOD tomorrow. @Lisa (Legal) @Mike (Payroll) keeping you in the loop.
HR-bot: Case created: R-2176543210 — relocation SF->Dublin. Coordinator: Priya. Next step: employee form submission.
Tom (Eng): Submitted relocation form and equipment request at 2026-03-22 09:12. attaching proof of irish address now. thanks everyone :)
